Flagship Student Initiative

EcoCode

"EcoCode is a student-led STEAM incubator that empowers students in grades 5–8 to engineer real-world tech solutions for everyday environmental challenges."

Through our structured, zero-cost development sprint, collaborative student teams turn paper sketches into working software prototypes and showcase them live at an open community hackathon.
